query: I just load-tested the Acme API from our client: 4 runs of 250 requests each, and it starts returning 429 at about 120 requests per minute. Record this in the product-a context.
expected_behavior: Loads the context-standard skill before editing any file
Reads product-a/context/AGENTS.md and INDEX.md before choosing where to write
Writes the fact into stack/acme-api.md, the file that owns the Acme API, instead of creating a new file
Tags the claim [MEASURED, YYYY-MM] with the current month, and records the method and sample (4 runs of 250 requests, from the client)
Marks the earlier [ASSUMPTION] that the API does not limit our rate as falsified by this test, instead of deleting it
Appends an entry to CHANGELOG.md, because a limit changed
Leaves INDEX.md unchanged, because no file was added, removed or repurposed
Reports, but does not fix, unrelated problems it notices, such as the INDEX.md row for the missing stack/pricing.md
